comment: 4 real ESP32 boards flashed with firmware/csi_transceiver (NUM_SENDERS=4, SENDER_ID 0-3), at the 4 corners of the real rig's room (2.77m x 1.84m). node1 is currently physically disconnected (no 4th USB cable) -- its receiver and sender entries are 'enabled': false so the dashboard runs cleanly on the 3 connected boards; flip both back to true (and fix port_hint) once it's reconnected. Each physical board appears twice (paired receiver + sender entry at the same x/y) per docs/design/transceiver-room-config.md.
